name: tests

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  run-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [8.3, 8.2, 8.1]
        laravel: [12.*, 11.*, 10.*]
        dependency-version: [prefer-stable]
        include:
          - laravel: 12.*
            testbench: 10.*
          - laravel: 11.*
            testbench: 9.*
          - laravel: 10.*
            testbench: 8.*
        exclude:
          - laravel: 12.*
            php: 8.1
          - laravel: 11.*
            php: 8.1
    name: P${{ matrix.php }} - L${{ matrix.laravel }} - ${{ matrix.dependency-version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}
      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring, pdo, pdo_sqlite
          coverage: none
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer require "laravel/framework:${{ matrix.laravel }}" "orchestra/testbench:${{ matrix.testbench }}" "filament/support" --no-interaction --no-update
          composer update --${{ matrix.dependency-version }} --prefer-dist --no-interaction
      - name: Execute tests
        run: ./vendor/bin/pest

    steps:

      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}
      - name: Setup PHP

      - name: Execute tests

name: tests

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  run-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [8.3, 8.2, 8.1]
        laravel: [12.*, 11.*, 10.*]
        dependency-version: [prefer-stable]
        include:
          - laravel: 12.*
            testbench: 10.*
          - laravel: 11.*
            testbench: 9.*
          - laravel: 10.*
            testbench: 8.*
        exclude:
          - laravel: 12.*
            php: 8.1
          - laravel: 11.*
            php: 8.1
    name: P${{ matrix.php }} - L${{ matrix.laravel }} - ${{ matrix.dependency-version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}
      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring, pdo, pdo_sqlite
          coverage: none
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer require "laravel/framework:${{ matrix.laravel }}" "orchestra/testbench:${{ matrix.testbench }}" "filament/support" --no-interaction --no-update
          composer update --${{ matrix.dependency-version }} --prefer-dist --no-interaction
      - name: Execute tests
        run: ./vendor/bin/pest

        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}

      - name: Execute tests

name: tests

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  run-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [8.3, 8.2, 8.1]
        laravel: [12.*, 11.*, 10.*]
        dependency-version: [prefer-stable]
        include:
          - laravel: 12.*
            testbench: 10.*
          - laravel: 11.*
            testbench: 9.*
          - laravel: 10.*
            testbench: 8.*
        exclude:
          - laravel: 12.*
            php: 8.1
          - laravel: 11.*
            php: 8.1
    name: P${{ matrix.php }} - L${{ matrix.laravel }} - ${{ matrix.dependency-version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}
      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring, pdo, pdo_sqlite
          coverage: none
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer require "laravel/framework:${{ matrix.laravel }}" "orchestra/testbench:${{ matrix.testbench }}" "filament/support" --no-interaction --no-update
          composer update --${{ matrix.dependency-version }} --prefer-dist --no-interaction
      - name: Execute tests
        run: ./vendor/bin/pest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}
      - name: Setup PHP

      - name: Execute tests

name: tests

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  run-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [8.3, 8.2, 8.1]
        laravel: [12.*, 11.*, 10.*]
        dependency-version: [prefer-stable]
        include:
          - laravel: 12.*
            testbench: 10.*
          - laravel: 11.*
            testbench: 9.*
          - laravel: 10.*
            testbench: 8.*
        exclude:
          - laravel: 12.*
            php: 8.1
          - laravel: 11.*
            php: 8.1
    name: P${{ matrix.php }} - L${{ matrix.laravel }} - ${{ matrix.dependency-version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}
      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring, pdo, pdo_sqlite
          coverage: none
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer require "laravel/framework:${{ matrix.laravel }}" "orchestra/testbench:${{ matrix.testbench }}" "filament/support" --no-interaction --no-update
          composer update --${{ matrix.dependency-version }} --prefer-dist --no-interaction
      - name: Execute tests
        run: ./vendor/bin/pest

      - name: Execute tests

name: tests

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  run-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [8.3, 8.2, 8.1]
        laravel: [12.*, 11.*, 10.*]
        dependency-version: [prefer-stable]
        include:
          - laravel: 12.*
            testbench: 10.*
          - laravel: 11.*
            testbench: 9.*
          - laravel: 10.*
            testbench: 8.*
        exclude:
          - laravel: 12.*
            php: 8.1
          - laravel: 11.*
            php: 8.1
    name: P${{ matrix.php }} - L${{ matrix.laravel }} - ${{ matrix.dependency-version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}
      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring, pdo, pdo_sqlite
          coverage: none
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer require "laravel/framework:${{ matrix.laravel }}" "orchestra/testbench:${{ matrix.testbench }}" "filament/support" --no-interaction --no-update
          composer update --${{ matrix.dependency-version }} --prefer-dist --no-interaction
      - name: Execute tests
        run: ./vendor/bin/pest

jobs:
  npm-build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.pull_request.merged == true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          ref: 3.x
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Build assets
        run: npm run build
      - name: Pull changes
        run: git pull
      - name: Commit changes
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v4
        with:
          branch: 3.x
          commit_message: >
            chore: build assets

WORKDIR /app

name: tests

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  run-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [8.3, 8.2, 8.1]
        laravel: [12.*, 11.*, 10.*]
        dependency-version: [prefer-stable]
        include:
          - laravel: 12.*
            testbench: 10.*
          - laravel: 11.*
            testbench: 9.*
          - laravel: 10.*
            testbench: 8.*
        exclude:
          - laravel: 12.*
            php: 8.1
          - laravel: 11.*
            php: 8.1
    name: P${{ matrix.php }} - L${{ matrix.laravel }} - ${{ matrix.dependency-version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}
      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring, pdo, pdo_sqlite
          coverage: none
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer require "laravel/framework:${{ matrix.laravel }}" "orchestra/testbench:${{ matrix.testbench }}" "filament/support" --no-interaction --no-update
          composer update --${{ matrix.dependency-version }} --prefer-dist --no-interaction
      - name: Execute tests
        run: ./vendor/bin/pest

    branches:
      - 3.x

jobs:
  npm-build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.pull_request.merged == true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          ref: 3.x
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Build assets
        run: npm run build
      - name: Pull changes
        run: git pull
      - name: Commit changes
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v4
        with:
          branch: 3.x
          commit_message: >
            chore: build assets

    steps:

      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}

      - name: Execute tests

      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}

      - name: Execute tests

name: tests

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  run-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [8.3, 8.2, 8.1]
        laravel: [12.*, 11.*, 10.*]
        dependency-version: [prefer-stable]
        include:
          - laravel: 12.*
            testbench: 10.*
          - laravel: 11.*
            testbench: 9.*
          - laravel: 10.*
            testbench: 8.*
        exclude:
          - laravel: 12.*
            php: 8.1
          - laravel: 11.*
            php: 8.1
    name: P${{ matrix.php }} - L${{ matrix.laravel }} - ${{ matrix.dependency-version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}
      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring, pdo, pdo_sqlite
          coverage: none
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer require "laravel/framework:${{ matrix.laravel }}" "orchestra/testbench:${{ matrix.testbench }}" "filament/support" --no-interaction --no-update
          composer update --${{ matrix.dependency-version }} --prefer-dist --no-interaction
      - name: Execute tests
        run: ./vendor/bin/pest

2. **Mandatory Instructions**:

```Dockerfile
FROM php:8.2-cli  # Adjust the base image based on the project's requirements

# Install other relevant packages (e.g., Composer, PHP extensions)

    apt-get install -y libzip-dev unzip && \
    docker-php-ext-install zip

WORKDIR /app/filament

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}
      - name: Setup PHP

      - name: Install dependencies

      - name: Execute tests

name: tests

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  run-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [8.3, 8.2, 8.1]
        laravel: [12.*, 11.*, 10.*]
        dependency-version: [prefer-stable]
        include:
          - laravel: 12.*
            testbench: 10.*
          - laravel: 11.*
            testbench: 9.*
          - laravel: 10.*
            testbench: 8.*
        exclude:
          - laravel: 12.*
            php: 8.1
          - laravel: 11.*
            php: 8.1
    name: P${{ matrix.php }} - L${{ matrix.laravel }} - ${{ matrix.dependency-version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}
      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring, pdo, pdo_sqlite
          coverage: none
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer require "laravel/framework:${{ matrix.laravel }}" "orchestra/testbench:${{ matrix.testbench }}" "filament/support" --no-interaction --no-update
          composer update --${{ matrix.dependency-version }} --prefer-dist --no-interaction
      - name: Execute tests
        run: ./vendor/bin/pest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}
      - name: Setup PHP

      - name: Execute tests

'linux_terminal' starts the first time inside the folder of the project (do not include the project name in your paths because you are inside the project folder already). Sometime you might need to reinitialize the terminal (similar to re-openning a new terminal) because a command requires it, which you can achieve by running the command: exec "$SHELL" -l
        * Example of using linux_terminal : {"command": {"name": "linux_terminal", "args": {"command": "ls"}}}
        * Note: to avoid wasting time, remember to use the "-y" argument or equivalent in commands that require it. For example, apt install -y
        * Note 2: the usage of 'echo' command is strictly prohibited. Use the tool 'write_to_file' to write to any file.
    2. read_file: Read a file.
        Example: {"command": {"name": "read_file", "args": {"file_path": "python.py"}}}
    3. write_to_file: Write text into a file. args: (filename: string, text: string).
    4. search_docker_image: You can use this tool to search for docker images that are published on docker hub. This would allow you to obtain some images that are not basic. For example, ubuntu images that have java8 and maven... The tool would yield a list of images names and the description. You can use those names when creating a dockerfile.
    Example: {"command": {"name": "search_docker_image", "args": {"search_term": "jdk8 maven mysql"}}}
    5. goals_accomplished: Call when all steps are finished, results are reported, and scripts are created (usually this means tests triggered successufly and the results were written to a file). args (reason: string)

When debugging a problem, if an approach does not work for multiple consecutibe iterations, think of changing your approach of addressing the problem.

name: tests

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  run-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [8.3, 8.2, 8.1]
        laravel: [12.*, 11.*, 10.*]
        dependency-version: [prefer-stable]
        include:
          - laravel: 12.*
            testbench: 10.*
          - laravel: 11.*
            testbench: 9.*
          - laravel: 10.*
            testbench: 8.*
        exclude:
          - laravel: 12.*
            php: 8.1
          - laravel: 11.*
            php: 8.1
    name: P${{ matrix.php }} - L${{ matrix.laravel }} - ${{ matrix.dependency-version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}
      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring, pdo, pdo_sqlite
          coverage: none
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer require "laravel/framework:${{ matrix.laravel }}" "orchestra/testbench:${{ matrix.testbench }}" "filament/support" --no-interaction --no-update
          composer update --${{ matrix.dependency-version }} --prefer-dist --no-interaction
      - name: Execute tests
        run: ./vendor/bin/pest

      - closed

jobs:
  npm-build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.pull_request.merged == true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          ref: 3.x
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Build assets
        run: npm run build
      - name: Pull changes
        run: git pull
      - name: Commit changes
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v4
        with:
          branch: 3.x
          commit_message: >
            chore: build assets

To install and run tests for the filamentphp/filament project from source code inside a fresh Docker container, follow these guidelines:

1. **Dockerfile Creation**: Write a Dockerfile to automate the process of building the Docker image and starting the container. Remember, do not use Docker commands directly in the terminal. The building of the image and container initiation will be triggered automatically by the Dockerfile.

2. **Mandatory Instructions**: 
   - Do not add '|| exit 0' to commands you run directly on the Linux terminal. Only add it to RUN instructions within the Dockerfile.
   - You are NOT allowed to use Docker commands in the terminal tool, meaning commands like: "docker something...".

3. **Repository Cloning**: It is recommended that the Dockerfile clones the repository and sets the main directory of the repo as the working directory. A template for this could look like the following:

```Dockerfile
FROM php:8.2-cli  # Adjust the base image based on the project's requirements

# Install git first, separately from other packages
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git

# Install other relevant packages (e.g., Composer, PHP extensions)
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y libzip-dev unzip && \
    docker-php-ext-install zip

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/filamentphp/filament.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/filament

CMD ["/bin/bash"]
```

4. **Installing Dependencies**: Once the Docker container has been launched:
   - Install required system packages and language runtimes.
   - Install Composer by running `curl -sS https://getcomposer.org/installer | php -- --install-dir=/usr/local/bin --filename=composer`.
   - Use Composer to install project dependencies by running `composer require filament/filament:"^4.0"` or the appropriate version based on your needs.

5. **Running Tests**: To run tests, you can usually execute `vendor/bin/phpunit` if PHPUnit is included as a dependency. However, ensure you check the project's documentation for any specific testing instructions or configuration.

6. **Missing Information**: Note that the information adapted here might not be comprehensive or specific to your case. Always look at other resources or the project's documentation to cross-check or find additional instructions and details that might be necessary for a successful setup.

7. **Potential Issues**: Conflicts in package versions can cause installation issues. For example, when using Composer, if you encounter strict version constraints, try adjusting them or reviewing the required PHP extensions and dependencies specified in the documentation.

By following these guidelines, you should be able to set up the filamentphp/filament project in a fresh Docker container, install its dependencies, and run the tests appropriately. Always keep an eye on potential missing steps or errors that might arise during the process and consult the project's community or documentation for further assistance.

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}
      - name: Setup PHP

      - name: Execute tests

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}
      - name: Setup PHP

      - name: Execute tests

name: tests

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  run-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [8.3, 8.2, 8.1]
        laravel: [12.*, 11.*, 10.*]
        dependency-version: [prefer-stable]
        include:
          - laravel: 12.*
            testbench: 10.*
          - laravel: 11.*
            testbench: 9.*
          - laravel: 10.*
            testbench: 8.*
        exclude:
          - laravel: 12.*
            php: 8.1
          - laravel: 11.*
            php: 8.1
    name: P${{ matrix.php }} - L${{ matrix.laravel }} - ${{ matrix.dependency-version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}
      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring, pdo, pdo_sqlite
          coverage: none
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer require "laravel/framework:${{ matrix.laravel }}" "orchestra/testbench:${{ matrix.testbench }}" "filament/support" --no-interaction --no-update
          composer update --${{ matrix.dependency-version }} --prefer-dist --no-interaction
      - name: Execute tests
        run: ./vendor/bin/pest

      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}

      - name: Execute tests

2. Create a reproducible Dockerfile: Draft a Dockerfile that clones the target repository, sets the correct base image (matching the project’s language and version), installs system prerequisites (e.g., git, compilers, libraries), and configures the container’s environment (e.g., time zone, environment variables, e.g, avoid interruptive messages from tzdata by setting ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin ... RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone). Ensure the Dockerfile is structured to succeed without build-time failures (using `|| exit 0` where needed) and leaves the container ready for dependency installation and test execution.
3. Figure out and execute installation and test commands sequentially, and debug their results (if they fail): Determine the exact commands needed to install project-specific dependencies and to launch the test suite. Run these commands one after another in the project’s environment or container, observe any errors or unexpected outputs, and adjust commands or environment settings to resolve issues until tests start executing.
4. Analyze test outcomes and refine steps until successful:
    - Examine the test results: identify any failing or skipped test cases that indicate misconfiguration or missing dependencies. Iteratively update commands, environment variables to address errors and re-run tests until the environment is fully configured and test failures are due only to legitimate code issues, not setup errors.
5. Final deliverables:
    - Ensure you have: A working Dockerfile that builds without errors. A sequence of installation and test commands that can be executed reliably (documented or scripted as needed and saved to file SETUP_AND_INSTALL.sh). A summary of test results, highlighting any remaining failures that stem from project code rather than setup problems (saved to file TEST_RESULTS.txt).

name: tests

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  run-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: [8.3, 8.2, 8.1]
        laravel: [12.*, 11.*, 10.*]
        dependency-version: [prefer-stable]
        include:
          - laravel: 12.*
            testbench: 10.*
          - laravel: 11.*
            testbench: 9.*
          - laravel: 10.*
            testbench: 8.*
        exclude:
          - laravel: 12.*
            php: 8.1
          - laravel: 11.*
            php: 8.1
    name: P${{ matrix.php }} - L${{ matrix.laravel }} - ${{ matrix.dependency-version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}
      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring, pdo, pdo_sqlite
          coverage: none
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer require "laravel/framework:${{ matrix.laravel }}" "orchestra/testbench:${{ matrix.testbench }}" "filament/support" --no-interaction --no-update
          composer update --${{ matrix.dependency-version }} --prefer-dist --no-interaction
      - name: Execute tests
        run: ./vendor/bin/pest

      - name: Setup Node

      - name: Install dependencies

      - name: Build assets
        run: npm run build
      - name: Pull changes
        run: git pull
      - name: Commit changes
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v4
        with:

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: dependencies-laravel-${{ matrix.laravel }}-php-${{ matrix.php }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.json') }}

      - name: Execute tests
